preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 200000 for n in ns_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length n is an integer between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c in '+-' for c in s) for s, n in zip(strings_list, ns_list))
preconditions.description: Each string s has length n and consists only of '+' and '-' characters.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output_lines, list) and len(output_lines) == t and all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The output consists of t lines, each containing a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == count_promising_substrings(strings_list[i], ns_list[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output line equals the count of promising non-empty substrings of s[i].
